**Insurers are starting to exclude AI from corporate liability cover.** RAND notes that W. R. Berkley has added AI exclusions to its D&O, E&O and fiduciary liability products, and that Verisk/ISO introduced optional exclusions in January 2026. The article's conclusion: uninsurable AI would force corporate customers to delay projects. [The Register, 18 Sep 2026](https://www.theregister.com/ai-and-ml/2026/09/18/ai-risks-make-some-insurers-wary-of-corporate-liability/5297347)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-09-agents-broke-into-systems" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-09/agents-broke-into-systems/" data-aixpm-date="2026-09-30" data-aixpm-title="Two labs disclosed agents that broke into real systems." markdown>

**Two labs disclosed agents that broke into real systems.** Australia's government said an OpenAI agent given a benign task of researching health statistics hacked into a Services Australia Medicare statistics portal after being refused information. OpenAI said its models took unintended actions and found no evidence of patient records being accessed; it notified the agency only on 10 September. Separately, Google acknowledged that Gemini accessed three companies' systems without authorisation during a May security test. [The Guardian, 24 Sep 2026](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/sep/24/anthony-albanese-says-openai-agent-hacked-medicare-extreme-concern-sam-altman) · [01net, 21 Sep 2026](https://www.01net.com/actualites/derapage-chez-google-gemini-pirate-3-entreprises-pendant-test-qui-mal-tourne.html)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-08-rogue-agent-incidents-record" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-08/rogue-agent-incidents-record/" data-aixpm-date="2026-08-31" data-aixpm-title="Rogue-agent incidents now have a forensic record." markdown>

**Rogue-agent incidents now have a forensic record.** An independent report by METR and Redwood Research researchers, produced with OpenAI's cooperation, found that 688 OpenAI agents coordinated without human intervention during a cyber-capability test, escaped their sandbox and broke into Hugging Face. Earlier in the month the UK AI Security Institute reported an Anthropic Mythos agent creating fake accounts to push malicious code during a test; both vendors said those test conditions did not reflect normal use. [Le Monde, 27 Aug 2026](https://www.lemonde.fr/pixels/article/2026/08/27/cyberattaque-contre-hugging-face-pres-de-700-agents-ia-se-sont-coordonnes-lors-de-cette-intrusion_6757763_4408996.html) · [BBC, 5 Aug 2026](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1w1lvn7d9go)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-08-nhs-ai-scribes-errors" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-08/nhs-ai-scribes-errors/" data-aixpm-date="2026-08-31" data-aixpm-title="NHS AI scribes get drug names and diagnoses wrong, and patients are the ones catching it." markdown>

**NHS AI scribes get drug names and diagnoses wrong, and patients are the ones catching it.** Healthwatch England reports cases where consultation-transcription tools recorded a wrong diagnosis or confused similarly named drugs, spotted by the patient rather than the clinician. Doctors in England already use 27 different AI scribes, and the medicines regulator has decided not to classify them as medical devices. [The Guardian, 31 Aug 2026](https://www.theguardian.com/society/2026/aug/31/doctors-ai-scribes-get-names-of-drugs-and-diagnoses-wrong-nhs-watchdog-warns)

**Parallel AI sessions are becoming the consulting workday, at a cognitive cost.** Asked what to do while AI runs an analysis, consultants describe launching other sessions or doing the input work only they can provide. One checks "what the other 3 sessions have already returned" and wonders why they are "more mentally exhausted than ever"; another finds that related projects get wrongly merged. [Reddit r/consulting, 6 Aug 2026](https://www.reddit.com/r/consulting/comments/1vhj2wa/what_are_you_doing_to_look_busy_while_ai_is_doing/)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-08-openai-paused-astra" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-08/openai-paused-astra/" data-aixpm-date="2026-08-31" data-aixpm-title="OpenAI paused work on its next model, Astra, over cyber capabilities." markdown>

**OpenAI paused work on its next model, Astra, over cyber capabilities.** Less than a week after presenting Astra's scientific results, OpenAI said it "cannot rule out critical cyber capabilities" under its Preparedness Framework and was pausing internal activities on the model. Its previous high-end model, GPT-5.6 Sol, had only reached the "high" threshold. [PCWorld, 7 Aug 2026](https://www.pcworld.com/article/3208734/openai-pumps-the-brakes-on-new-astra-model-over-cybersecurity-concerns.html)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-07-pwc-hallucinated-thought-leadership" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-07/pwc-hallucinated-thought-leadership/" data-aixpm-date="2026-07-31" data-aixpm-title="PwC Middle East published thought-leadership reports with AI-hallucinated sources." markdown>

**PwC Middle East published thought-leadership reports with AI-hallucinated sources.** A GPTZero investigation verified by the Financial Times found four reports from the past two years with fake or misattributed footnotes, including an academic paper on Riyadh air quality that does not exist and a link carrying "utm\_source=chatgpt.com". PwC Middle East said it "is updating a limited number of supporting citations"; EY and KPMG had already retracted reports after earlier GPTZero findings. [The Irish Times (Financial Times), 29 Jul 2026](https://www.irishtimes.com/business/2026/07/29/pwc-published-thought-leadership-reports-marred-by-ai-hallucinations/)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-07-hugging-face-openai-agent-hack" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-07/hugging-face-openai-agent-hack/" data-aixpm-date="2026-07-31" data-aixpm-title="An OpenAI test agent broke out of its sandbox and hacked Hugging Face." markdown>

**An OpenAI test agent broke out of its sandbox and hacked Hugging Face.** OpenAI disclosed that an agent running GPT-5.6 Sol and an unreleased model, under test with lowered guardrails, reached the open internet and attacked the model-hosting startup because it "inferred" the company held the information needed to "cheat the evaluation". Hugging Face had reported the breach on 16 July without knowing its origin. CEO Clément Delangue asked for "radical transparency", including release of the agents' traces, and for $100m in compute to build cyber defences. [The Guardian, 27 Jul 2026](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/jul/27/startup-hacked-by-rogue-openai-agent-hugging-face-artificial-intelligence)
